description: Manages partner organizations, including their creation, retrieval, updates, and deletion, along with associated metadata like logos and permissions.

endpoints.name: Create
endpoints.description: Creates a new partner organization with complete details including address, contact info, and organizational metadata.

req.description: Partner creation request with required fields

example_uses: Create a new partner called UNICEF
Add a new organization with website www.redcross.org
Register a new government partner from Bangladesh
Set up a partner organization with contact details
Create a global key account partner
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to add, create, register, or set up a new partner.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of partners with advanced filtering, pagination, search capabilities, and access control.

request.description: Partner filter request containing search and pagination parameters

searchCriteria.description: JSON string containing advanced search filters

searchText.description: Text to search across partner fields (override for request.searchText)

example_uses: Show me all partners
List partners containing 'UNICEF' in the name
Find partners with global key account status
Show active partners from my office
Search for government partners
Get partners sorted by name
Find partners in specific organizational unit
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to search, list, filter, or browse partners.

endpoints.name: Get
endpoints.description: Retrieves a specific partner by ID with complete details including documents, contacts, and office information.
example_uses: Show me details for partner ID 123
Get full information about partner 456
Display partner record 789
Get complete partner profile
Show partner with all related data
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks for specific partner details by ID or when you need complete partner information.

endpoints.name: Update
endpoints.description: Updates an existing partner's information including contact details, status, and organizational metadata.

req.description: Partner update request containing modified fields

example_uses: Update partner 123's name to New UNICEF
Change partner 456's status to Inactive
Update the website for partner 789
Modify partner contact information
Change partner office assignment
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to update, modify, edit, or change partner information.

endpoints.name: Delete
endpoints.description: Soft deletes a partner from the system (marks as deleted rather than permanent removal).
example_uses: Delete partner ID 123
Remove partner 456 from the system
Deactivate partner organization
Soft delete partner record
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to delete, remove, or eliminate a partner.

endpoints.name: PermissionsGet
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current user's permissions for a specific partner (read, update, delete).
example_uses: Check my permissions for partner 123
What can I do with partner 456?
Get access rights for this partner
Verify partner permissions
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you need to check user permissions before performing operations or showing UI elements.

endpoints.name: UploadLogo
endpoints.description: Uploads and associates a logo image with a partner (max 1MB, JPEG/PNG/WEBP only).
example_uses: Upload a logo for partner 123
Add organization logo to partner record
Set partner brand image
Update partner visual identity
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to add or update a partner's logo/image.

endpoints.name: GetPartnersByPartnerGroup
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated list of partners filtered by specific partner group code with access control and sorting.

code.description: Partner group code to filter by (e.g., 'GOV', 'NGO', 'UNAGENCY')

request.description: Pagination request containing page size and index

example_uses: Show all government partners (GOV group)
List all NGO partners with pagination
Get UN agency partners sorted by name
Find partners in a specific partner group classification
Show commercial partners (COMM group) with 20 per page
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to filter or search partners by partner group, organization type, or institutional classification.

endpoints.name: GetPartnersByPartnerCategory
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated list of partners filtered by specific partner category code with access control and sorting.

code.description: Partner category code to filter by (e.g., 'NATIONAL', 'INTERNATIONAL', 'BILATERAL')

request.description: Pagination request containing page size and index

example_uses: Show all national partners in this category
List international partners with pagination
Get bilateral partners sorted by name
Find partners in a specific operational category
Show multilateral partners with 15 per page
Filter partners by geographic or operational scope
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to filter or search partners by partner category, operational scope, or geographic classification.
